XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Restoring engine start-up following an impact

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
The vehicle is equipped with a fire prevention system called FPS (Fire Prevention System) .

Following a minor collision, the FPS system intervenes as follows:

- Fuel supply from the injection control unit is interrupted
- Unlocking of doors
- Activation of interior light
- Activation of emergency lights
- The message "FPS ON" or "Fuel cut-off activated" appears on the instrument panel

Engine start-up recovery procedure:

1- Turn on the ignition
2- Move the turn signal lever to turn on the right turn signal
3- Move the stalk switch to turn off the right turn signal
4- Move the stalk switch to turn on the left turn signal
5- Move the stalk to turn off the left turn signal
6- Move the stalk to turn on the right turn signal
7- Move the stalk to turn off the right turn signal
8- Move the stalk to turn on the left turn signal
9- Move the stalk switch to turn off the left turn signal
10- Turn off the ignition

The FPS system is now deactivated, and you can start the engine
On some vehicles, the manual procedure may not be possible. In this case, proceed with the diagnostic equipment.
